chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from Ibn Muskan who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the meat of donkeys, so he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade eating it on the day of Khaybar.
He said, And I asked him about eating horses and mules, so he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade it, so do not eat them unless you are compelled to do so.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating donkey, horse, and mule meat in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi distinguishes between the permanent prohibition of domestic donkey meat, rooted in the Prophet's decree at Khaybar, and the conditional prohibition of horse and mule meat, which permits consumption during necessity (idtirar). Shia jurists utilize this distinction to derive rulings on the permissibility of various animals based on the degree of prohibition and the presence of exigency, reflecting the practical application of prophetic tradition in dietary law.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about meat of the donkeys. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade from eating it on the day of Khyber’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about eating the cavalry horse, and the mules. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade from it, therefore do not eat it, except if you are desperate for it’.
en.sarwar: 13. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from ibn Muskan who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, about the flesh of donkeys. He (the Imam) said, ‘The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, prohibited using it for food on the day of Khaybar.’

I asked him (the Imam) about using horses and mules for food. He (the Imam) said, ’The Messenger of Allah has prohibited using them for food, so do not use them for food unless it is due to necessity and you are compelled.’”
